coordinateSystem: glTF right-handed Y-up; distances in metres
scope: Numerical export and skin audit. Artistic deformation quality requires separate rendered review.

staticIdentity.comparison: Indexed triangle corners; export may split vertices for normals or weights.

metricNotes.edgeRatios: Edges shorter than 1 mm excluded only from ratio statistics; extension includes every edge.
metricNotes.floors: Shoe-sole vertices with bind Y < 0.06 m and Foot/ToeBase influence > 0.6; airborne clearance allowed.
metricNotes.thresholds: All sampled coordinates finite and <5 m magnitude; sole above -5 mm. Roundtrip tolerance: 0.1 mm versus authored blend (export interpolation), 0.02 mm versus independent glTF LBS. Edge and normal metrics are diagnostic, not artistic pass criteria.
